description: Work out the reorder point and safety stock for one item (continuous review: reorder when stock on hand plus on order falls to the reorder point). Send the average demand per period, the standard deviation of that demand, the lead time in the same periods (and its standard deviation if lead times vary), and either a service level in percent (z is read from the standard normal distribution) or z itself. Get back z, demand during the lead time, its standard deviation, the safety stock and the reorder point (exact and rounded up to whole units). Send inventory_position (on hand + on order - backorders) to be told whether to reorder now. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/reorder-point). Not legal, tax or financial advice.

avg_demand.description: Average demand per period in units (per day, week or month: the same period as the lead time).

demand_std_dev.description: Standard deviation of demand per period, in units (0 if demand never varies).

inventory_position.description: Optional: units on hand + on order - backorders now, to get reorder_now or above_reorder_point.

lead_time.description: Average replenishment lead time, in the same periods as the demand (for example 4 for 4 days).

lead_time_std_dev.description: Optional: standard deviation of the lead time, in the same periods (default 0: the lead time is fixed).

period.description: The period both demand and lead time are given in (only used in the words of the answer; default day).

service_level_percent.description: Cycle service level in percent: the chance of not running out during one lead time (95 for 95%). Send this or z.

z.description: Safety factor z, if you already have it (1.65 for about 95%). Send this or service_level_percent.
